compose.close.description: Accessible name of the × button that closes the new-post sheet. The draft is kept.

compose.completion.suggestions.description: Accessible name of the list of suggestions that opens under the text of a post, a content warning or a profile while the user types a mention after @, a hashtag after # or an emoji after : (ADR-0092).

compose.completion.count.description: Announced to screen readers when the list of suggestions for the typed mention, hashtag or emoji opens or changes. {count} is how many suggestions it shows.

compose.completion.loading.description: Shown in the place of the suggestions, and announced, while the suggestions for the typed mention or hashtag take a moment to arrive.

compose.completion.empty.description: Shown in the place of the suggestions, and announced, when nothing matches the typed mention, hashtag or emoji.

compose.completion.tag_posts.description: How many public posts carry a hashtag, shown after the hashtag in the list of suggestions while the user types a hashtag. {count} is the number of posts.

compose.failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível enviar a publicação: {reason}
compose.failed.description: Error after publishing a post failed. The draft is kept. {reason} is the error message.

compose.language.label.description: Label of the choice of the language a post is written in.

compose.language.und.description: Choice of post language when the user does not say which language the post is in.

compose.media.add.description: Button that opens the file picker to attach images, a video, or an audio file to a post.

compose.media.count.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# arquivo anexado} other {# arquivos anexados}}
compose.media.count.description: Description of the button that attaches media, while the post has some. {count} is how many files.

compose.media.description.hint.defaultMessage: Descreva para quem não pode ver ou ouvir.
compose.media.description.hint.description: Help text under the alternative text field of an attached image, video, or audio file.

compose.media.description.label.description: Label of the alternative text field of an attached image, video, or audio file. {position} is its number in the post, from 1.

compose.media.description.required.defaultMessage: Descreva para quem não pode ver ou ouvir. Suas configurações pedem uma descrição de cada anexo.
compose.media.description.required.description: Help text under the alternative text field of an attachment when the user's settings ask for a description of every attachment.

compose.media.description.server_require.defaultMessage: Descreva para quem não pode ver ou ouvir. Este servidor exige uma descrição de cada anexo.
compose.media.description.server_require.description: Help text under the alternative text field of an attached image, video, or audio file when the server requires a description of every image (the instance setting require_media_description).

compose.media.description.missing.defaultMessage: Adicione uma descrição a este anexo. Este servidor exige uma para cada anexo.
compose.media.description.missing.description: Error of the alternative text field of an attached image, video, or audio file that has no description while the server requires one for every image.

compose.media.drop.description: Shown over the new-post form while the user drags files over it: dropping them attaches them to the post.

compose.media.failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível anexar o arquivo: {reason}
compose.media.failed.description: State of an attached file whose upload failed. {reason} is the error message.

compose.media.failed_processing.defaultMessage: O servidor não conseguiu processar este arquivo.
compose.media.failed_processing.description: Why an attached file failed: the server could not process it.

compose.media.hint.defaultMessage: Até {max, plural, other {# arquivos}}: imagens JPEG, PNG, GIF ou WebP, vídeo MP4 ou WebM, ou áudio MP3, Ogg ou M4A. A localização e outros metadados são removidos.
compose.media.hint.description: Help text next to the button that attaches media. {max} is the most files a post can have. JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, MP4, WebM, MP3, Ogg, M4A are format names (not translated).

compose.media.list.description: Accessible name of the list of images, videos, and audio files attached to the post being written.

compose.media.processing.description: State of an attached file while the server prepares it.

compose.media.remove.description: Button that removes an attached file from the post. {position} is its number in the post, from 1.

compose.media.too_many.defaultMessage: Uma publicação pode ter no máximo {max, plural, other {# arquivos}}. Os demais não foram adicionados.
compose.media.too_many.description: Notice when the user picked more files than a post can have. {max} is the most files a post can have.

compose.media.unsupported.defaultMessage: {name} não é uma imagem JPEG, PNG, GIF ou WebP, um vídeo MP4 ou WebM, nem um arquivo de áudio MP3, Ogg ou M4A.
compose.media.unsupported.description: Notice when a picked file is not a type the server accepts. {name} is the file name. The format names are not translated.

compose.media.uploading.description: State of an attached file while it is being sent to the server.

compose.mention.unreached.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {{accounts} está em outro servidor e não segue você, então não receberá esta publicação. Fora deste servidor, as publicações de “Este servidor” chegam só aos seus seguidores, que veem esta menção como um link simples.} other {{accounts} estão em outros servidores e não seguem você, então não receberão esta publicação. Fora deste servidor, as publicações de “Este servidor” chegam só aos seus seguidores, que veem estas menções como links simples.}}
compose.mention.unreached.description: Warning under a post with the visibility 'This server' that mentions accounts of other servers that do not follow the author (ADR-0017): those accounts do not receive the post, and the author's followers on other servers see the mention as a plain link, not as a mention. {accounts} is the list of their handles, for example '@carol@remote.example and @dave@other.example'; {count} is how many there are.

compose.federation.stays_local.defaultMessage: Esta publicação não chegará a outros servidores: este servidor não envia publicações a eles agora, então as contas de outros servidores a que ela responde ou que menciona não a receberão.
compose.federation.stays_local.description: Warning under a post that replies to or mentions an account of another server while this server sends nothing to other servers (federation direction 'Receive only' or 'Off', ADR-0006).

compose.missing_description.add.description: Button of the confirmation that goes back to the form to describe the images.

compose.missing_description.body.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# imagem não tem descrição.} other {# imagens não têm descrição.}} Quem não pode ver as imagens não saberá o que elas mostram.
compose.missing_description.body.description: Text of the confirmation about images without a description. {count} is how many images have none.

compose.missing_description.post.description: Button of the confirmation that posts without the descriptions.

compose.missing_description.title.description: Title of the confirmation shown when attached images have no description and the user's settings ask for one.

compose.open.description: The coral button in the phones' tab bar and the button in the side rail that open the form for a new post. In the compact rail (tablets) only its icon shows and this is its accessible name; keep it short.

compose.outbox.discard.description: Button that throws away a post that could not be sent.

compose.outbox.edit.description: Button that puts a post that could not be sent back into the form.

compose.outbox.failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível enviar a publicação: {reason}
compose.outbox.failed.description: State of a post that could not be sent. {reason} is the error message.

compose.outbox.label.description: Accessible name of the list of posts that are being sent or could not be sent.

compose.outbox.resend.description: Button that sends a post that could not be sent again.

compose.outbox.sending.description: State of a post that is being sent.

compose.outbox.unsent.description: State of a post whose sending was interrupted (for example by reloading the page).

compose.over.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# caractere a mais} other {# caracteres a mais}}
compose.over.description: Counter under a text field when the text is longer than allowed. {count} is how many characters are over.

compose.poll.toggle.description: Toggle button (an icon) that adds a poll to the new post, or removes it. A post with a poll attaches no files.

compose.poll.legend.description: Name of the group of fields of the poll of the new post: its options, how long it lasts, and its settings.

compose.poll.option.description: Label of a text field of the poll of the new post: one option the readers can vote for. {number} is its position, from 1.

compose.poll.option.remove.description: Button (an icon) that removes an option of the poll of the new post. {number} is its position, from 1.

compose.poll.option.add.description: Button that adds an empty option to the poll of the new post.

compose.poll.duplicate.description: Error under the options of the poll of the new post when two of them are the same.

compose.poll.duration.description: Label of the select of how long the poll of the new post takes votes.

compose.poll.duration.minutes.description: Option of how long a poll takes votes. {count} is a number of minutes.

compose.poll.duration.hours.description: Option of how long a poll takes votes. {count} is a number of hours.

compose.poll.duration.days.description: Option of how long a poll takes votes. {count} is a number of days.

compose.poll.multiple.description: Checkbox of the poll of the new post: a vote may choose several options.

compose.poll.hide_totals.defaultMessage: Ocultar os votos até a enquete terminar
compose.poll.hide_totals.description: Checkbox of the poll of the new post: nobody sees the votes of each option until the poll ends.

compose.posted.description: Notice after a post was published.

compose.posted.first.defaultMessage: Você fez sua primeira publicação. Boas-vindas.
compose.posted.first.description: Notice after the account's first post was published: the post is done, and the account has started posting.

compose.remaining.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# caractere restante} other {# caracteres restantes}}
compose.remaining.description: Counter under a text field: how many more characters fit. {count} is a number.

compose.reply.cancel.description: Button that turns the reply being written into a normal post.

compose.reply.label.description: Above the new-post form: the post being replied to. {name} is the author's display name or handle.

compose.reply.unavailable.defaultMessage: A publicação que você está respondendo não pode ser exibida.
compose.reply.unavailable.description: Shown instead of the post being replied to when it could not be loaded.

compose.sensitive.defaultMessage: Ocultar as imagens até os leitores as mostrarem
compose.sensitive.description: Checkbox that marks the attached images as sensitive.

compose.submit.description: Button that publishes the new post.

compose.submit.reply.description: Button that publishes the reply being written.

compose.text.label.description: Label of the text area where the user writes the text of a post.

compose.title.description: Heading of the form that writes a new post (the side panel on wide screens, the sheet on phones).

compose.visibility.button.description: Button that opens the choice of who can see the post. {visibility} is the current choice, for example 'Public'.

compose.visibility.ceiling.defaultMessage: Sua conta pode publicar, no máximo, como “{visibility}” agora. Uma escolha mais ampla é publicada como “{visibility}”.
compose.visibility.ceiling.description: Hint in the choice of visibility while a restriction on the account narrows what it can post. {visibility} is the widest visibility it can use, for example 'Followers'.

compose.visibility.direct.description: Visibility of a post: only the mentioned people.

compose.visibility.direct.description.defaultMessage: Somente as pessoas que você menciona.

compose.visibility.done.description: Button that closes the list of visibility choices.

compose.visibility.limited.defaultMessage: Publicada com a visibilidade “{visibility}”: sua conta não pode publicar de forma mais ampla agora.
compose.visibility.limited.description: Notice after posting when the server narrowed the chosen visibility because of a restriction on the account. {visibility} is the visibility the post got, for example 'Followers'.

compose.visibility.local.description: Visibility of a post: signed-in people of this server and the author's followers. Not the same as 'local only' in other software: followers on other servers receive it.

compose.visibility.local.description.defaultMessage: Pessoas conectadas aqui e seus seguidores em outros servidores. Aparece na linha do tempo local deste servidor.

compose.visibility.private.description: Visibility of a post: the author's followers and the mentioned people.

compose.visibility.private.description.defaultMessage: Somente seus seguidores e as pessoas que você menciona.

compose.visibility.public.description: Visibility of a post: everyone, and listed on the public timelines.

compose.visibility.public.description.defaultMessage: Qualquer pessoa, aqui e em outros servidores. Aparece nas linhas do tempo públicas.

compose.visibility.title.description: Label of the list of visibility choices for a post.

compose.visibility.translation.both.defaultMessage: Quando alguém pede uma tradução, o texto de uma publicação “{first}” ou “{second}” pode ser enviado a {providers}.
compose.visibility.translation.both.description: In the visibility picker, on a server that allows a translation provider both narrow visibilities: what can happen to such a post. {first} and {second} are visibility names, {providers} the names of the providers as a list.

compose.visibility.translation.one.defaultMessage: Quando alguém pede uma tradução, o texto de uma publicação “{visibility}” pode ser enviado a {providers}.
compose.visibility.translation.one.description: In the visibility picker, on a server that allows a translation provider one narrow visibility: what can happen to such a post. {visibility} is the visibility's name, {providers} the names of the providers as a list.

compose.visibility.unlisted.description: Visibility of a post: everyone, but kept off the public timelines.

compose.visibility.unlisted.description.defaultMessage: Qualquer pessoa com o link, mas não aparece nas linhas do tempo públicas.

compose.warning.description.defaultMessage: Os leitores veem isto primeiro e escolhem se mostram a publicação.
compose.warning.description.description: Help text under the content warning field.

compose.warning.label.description: Label of the field with the content warning text of a post.

compose.warning.toggle.description: Toggle button (an icon) that adds a content warning: a short text shown instead of the post until the reader opens it.

compose.quote.label.description: Heading above the new-post form of the post being quoted. {name} is the display name, or the @handle, of its author.

compose.quote.cancel.description: Button under the post being quoted in the new-post form; the draft then quotes nothing.

compose.quote.unavailable.defaultMessage: Não foi possível carregar a publicação a citar.
compose.quote.unavailable.description: Shown in place of the post being quoted in the new-post form when it could not be loaded.

compose.quote_policy.label.description: Accessible name of the select in the new-post form that chooses who may quote the post.

compose.quote_policy.public.description: Quote policy: anyone who can see the post may quote it.

compose.quote_policy.public.description.defaultMessage: Qualquer pessoa que possa ver a publicação pode citá-la.

compose.quote_policy.followers.description: Quote policy: only the author's followers may quote the post.

compose.quote_policy.nobody.description: Quote policy: only the author may quote the post.

compose.quote_policy.nobody.description.defaultMessage: Ninguém além de você pode citá-la.
compose.quote_policy.nobody.description.description: Description of the quote policy 'Only you'.

compose.quote_policy.tooltip.description: Tooltip of the select that chooses who may quote the post, shown on hover and keyboard focus. {value} is the current choice, for example 'Followers'.

compose.language.tooltip.description: Tooltip of the select that chooses the language of the post, shown on hover and keyboard focus. {value} is the current language, for example 'English'.

compose.blocked.empty.description: Beside the submit button of the new-post form, after it was pressed with an empty text: why the post was not sent. The focus moves to the text.

compose.blocked.too_long.defaultMessage: O texto é longo demais. Encurte-o para publicar.
compose.blocked.too_long.description: Beside the submit button of the new-post form, after it was pressed with a text over the character limit: why the post was not sent. The counter under the text shows by how much.

compose.blocked.uploading.defaultMessage: Os anexos ainda estão sendo enviados. Publique quando estiverem prontos.
compose.blocked.uploading.description: Beside the submit button of the new-post form, after it was pressed while attached files were still uploading or being processed: why the post was not sent.

compose.blocked.upload_failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível enviar um anexo. Remova-o para publicar.
compose.blocked.upload_failed.description: Beside the submit button of the new-post form, after it was pressed while an attached file had failed: why the post was not sent.

compose.blocked.poll.defaultMessage: Corrija as opções da enquete para publicar.
compose.blocked.poll.description: Beside the submit button of the new-post form, after it was pressed while the poll had an empty or repeated option: why the post was not sent. The poll shows which.

compose.blocked.loading_target.defaultMessage: A publicação que você responde ou cita ainda está carregando. Publique quando ela aparecer.
compose.blocked.loading_target.description: Beside the submit button of the new-post form, after it was pressed while the post replied to or quoted was still loading: why the post was not sent.

compose.rejected.appeal.already_appealed.defaultMessage: Você já contestou esta decisão. Um moderador vai analisá-la.
compose.rejected.appeal.already_appealed.description: Shown in place of the appeal button when the user already appealed the automated review's refusal of their post.

compose.rejected.appeal.cancel.description: Button of the appeal dialog of a refused post: closes it without appealing. The draft is kept.

compose.rejected.appeal.characters_left.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# caractere restante} other {# caracteres restantes}}
compose.rejected.appeal.characters_left.description: Count under a field of the appeal of a refused post. {count} is how many more characters fit.

compose.rejected.appeal.characters_over.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# caractere a mais} other {# caracteres a mais}}
compose.rejected.appeal.characters_over.description: Count under a field of the appeal of a refused post that is too long. {count} is how many characters are over.

compose.rejected.appeal.closed.defaultMessage: O prazo para contestar terminou em {date}.
compose.rejected.appeal.closed.description: Shown in place of the appeal button once the deadline to appeal the refusal of a post passed. {date} is the deadline.

compose.rejected.appeal.comment.descript.defaultMessage: Opcional. Diga aos moderadores por que a publicação deve ser permitida.
compose.rejected.appeal.comment.descript.description: Description of the comment field of the appeal of a refused post.

compose.rejected.appeal.comment.label.description: Label of the optional comment field of the appeal of a post the automated review refused.

compose.rejected.appeal.comment.too_long.description: Error of the comment of the appeal of a refused post that is too long. {max} is the limit.

compose.rejected.appeal.confirm.descript.defaultMessage: Um moderador lê o texto e o seu comentário. O recurso não publica a publicação: se o moderador cancelar a decisão, você poderá publicá-la de novo. Você não pode alterar o recurso depois de enviá-lo.
compose.rejected.appeal.confirm.descript.description: Description of the appeal dialog of a post the automated review refused.

compose.rejected.appeal.confirm.title.description: Title of the dialog that appeals the automated review's refusal of a post.

compose.rejected.appeal.failed.defaultMessage: Não foi possível enviar o recurso: {reason}
compose.rejected.appeal.failed.description: Error in the appeal dialog of a refused post when sending failed; the dialog stays open. {reason} says why.

compose.rejected.appeal.not_appealable.defaultMessage: Esta decisão não pode ser contestada.
compose.rejected.appeal.not_appealable.description: Shown in place of the appeal button when the server says the refusal of the post cannot be appealed.

compose.rejected.appeal.open.description: Button under the notice of a post the automated review refused: opens the appeal dialog.

compose.rejected.appeal.send.description: Button of the appeal dialog of a refused post that sends the appeal.

compose.rejected.appeal.sent.defaultMessage: Seu recurso foi enviado. Um moderador vai analisá-lo e você será notificado; se ele cancelar a decisão, você poderá publicar de novo.
compose.rejected.appeal.sent.description: Shown in the notice of a refused post after the appeal was sent.

compose.rejected.appeal.upheld.defaultMessage: Um moderador manteve a decisão em {date}. Esta publicação continua não publicada.
compose.rejected.appeal.upheld.description: Notice of the composer after the author appealed a refused post: a moderator reviewed the appeal and kept the refusal. {date} is the date and time of the review.

compose.rejected.appeal.overturned.defaultMessage: Um moderador cancelou a decisão em {date}. Você pode publicar de novo.
compose.rejected.appeal.overturned.description: Notice of the composer after the author appealed a refused post: a moderator overturned the refusal. The post is not restored; the author posts again. {date} is the date and time of the review.

compose.rejected.appeal.text.description.defaultMessage: O texto que você tentou publicar. Os moderadores o leem como texto simples.
compose.rejected.appeal.text.description.description: Description of the text field of the appeal of a refused post, which starts with the text that was sent.

compose.rejected.appeal.text.label.description: Label of the text field of the appeal of a post the automated review refused.

compose.rejected.appeal.text.required.description: Error of the appeal of a refused post whose text is empty.

compose.rejected.appeal.text.too_long.description: Error of the text of the appeal of a refused post that is too long. {max} is the limit.

compose.rejected.appeal.until.description: Shown above the appeal button of a post the automated review refused. {date} is the deadline.

compose.rejected.appeal.window_closed.defaultMessage: O prazo para contestar esta decisão terminou.
compose.rejected.appeal.window_closed.description: Shown in place of the appeal button when the server says the deadline to appeal the refusal of the post passed.
